fusions.name: Scratch It Under
fusions.desc: Finishes weakened prey and scrapes earth over it for 20 damage, consuming every affliction on the target and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Gravel Spray
fusions.desc: Kicks loose dirt back in a ring, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles with a 30% chance to leave each one [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Covered Tracks
fusions.desc: You scrape earth over your trail and are veiled for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Clawed Back Out
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
